facts.fact: BCEAO launched PI-SPI on 30 September 2025, a 24/7 interoperable instant payment platform for the UEMOA, and reports 80 participants connected on 2 April 2026 (communique).
Niger is a UEMOA member state on the regional PI-SPI platform that BCEAO runs, with its institutions required to connect by 30 June 2026.
